subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: After the dropped-summary path is repaired, should compaction adopt the existing prompt-send policy of dropping aborted assistant tool-call turns before summarization instead of synthesizing results?
rationale: The code repair is mechanical, but drop-vs-synthesize controls how much partial aborted-turn context survives after provider timeouts and needs explicit session-state policy ownership.

options.title: Accept Drop Policy
options.body: Proceed with this PR after the dropped-summary repair because it matches sibling replay behavior and prevents strict-provider session breakage with bounded context loss.

options.title: Require Synthetic Recovery
options.body: Ask for a revised patch that preserves aborted turns by synthesizing explicit tool results, accepting a larger and more provider-sensitive policy surface.

options.title: Pause For Recovery Design
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers design richer aborted-turn recovery, leaving the current compaction failure open meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Accept Drop Policy
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR after the dropped-summary repair because it matches sibling replay behavior and prevents strict-provider session breakage with bounded context loss.
